session.title: Switchy 1.0.24: configs handed back when Windows ends the session; 1.0.24 released
session.purpose: After a Windows restart every Claude Code agent failed with 'Connection refused (ECONNREFUSED)' until Switchy was restarted by hand; find why and fix it. Then date the changelog, push, update the public repo and release 1.0.24.
outcomes: Root cause: Windows restart (12:06:47 initiated, boot 12:08:17) killed Switchy without RunEvent::ExitRequested, so the takeover was never undone: ~/.claude/settings.json (and Codex/Gemini, Windows and WSL) kept ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:15721 while nothing listened until Switchy started at 12:09:52, which logged 'Previous run exited abnormally (takeover leftovers found)'. No crash event; the old log simply stops at 12:07:10.

Fix (commit 620b1c8c): tao turns WM_ENDSESSION into RunEvent::Exit; lib.rs handles it on Windows by blocking (4 s timeout) on ProxyService::hand_back_for_session_end, which restores the Windows configs first, then the WSL mirrors, then clears the takeover flag and backups. Proxy state stays enabled, so the next start retakes the configs. restore_mirror moved from the inner restore into its locked wrapper so the hand-back can order native before WSL.

Verified on the installed build by sending WM_QUERYENDSESSION/WM_ENDSESSION to Switchy's 'Tao Thread Event Target' window (scratch script, not kept): handled in 55 ms; ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL went from http://127.0.0.1:15721 to https://api.anthropic.com, Codex/Gemini and both WSL copies restored; relaunch logged no abnormal-exit warning, took all three over again and served Claude traffic. 479/480 proxy tests pass; the one failure also fails on the unchanged tree because it binds port 15721, which the running Switchy holds.

Released 1.0.24 (changelog dated 2026-10-06): private origin pushed to 9b27b890, public registered2nd/switchy republished by scripts/publish_public.sh, build-macos.yml run 37519945814 on the public repo built Switchy_1.0.24_aarch64.dmg (now in installers/), release https://github.com/registered2nd/switchy/releases/tag/v1.0.24 is Latest with exe, msi and dmg. gh release create failed twice with GitHub 504/500 (draft auto-deleted, tag left); draft + per-file upload + publish worked.
session.latest_summary: 1.0.24 released: Switchy now hands Claude Code/Codex/Gemini configs back when Windows restarts, so agents no longer hit ECONNREFUSED before Switchy starts.

current_focus.summary: 1.0.24 is released (Codex 0.160 websocket relay, Windows-restart hand-back): confirm its unverified paths on live traffic and a real restart, and install it on another user's MacBook once that machine is reachable.

next_actions.summary: CONFIRM 1.0.24'S UNVERIFIED PATHS ON LIVE TRAFFIC. In C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log: when a Codex account hits its limit, expect '[CodexWS] provider=… refused the turn for usage; sent it again on provider=…' and the turn completing in Codex with no error; long Codex sessions should no longer close with 'Message too long'. In ~/.switchy/switchy.db proxy_request_logs, websocket rows (is_streaming=1, app_type codex) should carry session_id 'codex_<Codex session uuid>'. Only registered2nd and user-b.zhang serve Codex; registered2nd's weekly window resets 2026-10-09 21:00.

CONFIRM THE RESTART HAND-BACK ON A REAL WINDOWS RESTART (only simulated so far). After the user's next restart, the last lines of C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.prev.log should be 'Session ending; handing the live configs back' and 'Live configs handed back for the session end', the first start in switchy.log should have no 'Previous run exited abnormally' warning, and Claude Code opened before Switchy starts should answer instead of ECONNREFUSED. A 'timed out' line means the 4 s bound was hit (likely the WSL copies).

INSTALL ON CHELSEA'S MACBOOK when reachable (ssh chelsea-mac; doorway 20722 refused all of 2026-10-01). Copy installers/Switchy_<latest>_aarch64.dmg over, hdiutil attach, copy Switchy.app into /Applications, xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Switchy.app, open it. She signs in to each account herself; never copy a login from the user's machines. The latest is installers/Switchy_1.0.24_aarch64.dmg (also on the v1.0.24 release).

Wait for the user's feedback on 1.0.24 (Codex 0.160 websocket, Windows-restart hand-back), 1.0.23 (Codex image generation through the proxy) and 1.0.22. When a Codex account switch happens during a running turn, confirm in C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log the line '[codex_engine] ... is mid-turn; signing it in to provider=... once it is idle' and that the turn completes; a passing fault shows '[FWD-003]' and should not switch accounts. A release is: bump the four version files, changelog section, CI=true pnpm build, commit, push origin, run scripts/publish_public.sh, run build-macos.yml on registered2nd/switchy (gh workflow run -R registered2nd/switchy), download its DMG into installers/ (rename over the old one) with the macOS line in the changelog section, commit, push, publish again, then release on registered2nd/switchy with the exe, msi and dmg. If gh release create fails with 5xx, create a --draft with --verify-tag, gh release upload each file, then gh release edit --draft=false --latest.

VERIFY LOCAL PROXY OFF WITH AN OPEN CODEX WINDOW. the user was asked to turn Local proxy off in Settings > Pool, then use a Codex window opened while the proxy was on. Confirm in C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log that "Proxy turned off; its listener stays up..." was logged, that the Codex window's later [Codex] requests still reached the proxy and answered, that netstat shows 127.0.0.1:15721 still LISTENING, and that Settings shows the proxy as off. Turning it back on must reuse the listener.

QUIT CASE WAITS ON STEPHEN. Quitting Switchy still breaks Codex windows opened under the proxy. He was offered a warning on quit naming the open Codex windows (small) or running the proxy as a process that outlives Switchy's window (large); he has not chosen. Build nothing until he does.
If the user directs request logging to be enabled, first make the Usage page's Turn on button apply to the running proxy, then enable it for Claude, Codex, and Gemini.
